summary: Dollar depreciation (USD/INR ₹94.40) is the primary mechanism driving copper strength this session. Weaker US currency makes rupee-priced metals cheaper for overseas buyers and mechanically boosts INR-denominated commodity quotes. This narrative is confirmed across the complex: silver +2.27%, natgas +2.71% — all benefiting from currency tailwinds rather than supply-side tightness.
